Amy learned a lot about science. There are always many people at the lantern street. Owen is interested in swimming. I finally found my misplaced keys under the sofa.
Amy is going to travel to Sydney in January. Amy wrote about the day in the diary. Amy and Owen had great fun there. The guard held the door firmly against the wind.
